envelope.description: Give the record-folder helpers an explicit intent

body.title: Give the record-folder helpers an explicit intent
body.summary: Give buildRecordFolderArgs, storyRecordFolderArgs, buildRecordPathsFor, testRecordPaths and storyWorkflowFiles an explicit PathIntent (read, or write with a root). The write form returns the first of a persisted BUILD or TESTS stamp, resolveEpicAnchor, then the root. persistTestRecordTask and persistBuildRecord use write intent and store epicCreatedAt through folderIdentityMeta. Update own-files.ts, standalone-record.ts and test-record.ts.
acceptanceChecks: read intent raises MissingAnchorError when nothing anchors; write intent uses the root
the first headless TESTS write stamps the anchor and a later BUILD reads it into the same folder
the chain of upstream, head and own createdAt fallbacks is gone
the build record and test record tests pass
